capabilities: Highlight sentences over a configurable word threshold
Apply background or underline highlighting with custom colors
Update highlights in real time in editing and reading modes
Run commands to highlight or clear highlights
extras: Desktop-only and tested on Linux only; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
motivation: The author built it mainly for themselves to keep sentences brief while writing a novel.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to flag overly long sentences, which can make prose harder to read.
summary: Obsidian plugin that highlights sentences exceeding a configurable word-count threshold to improve writing clarity.
